market.what: Cu electroplating chemistry for advanced packaging (pillar, bump, RDL, TSV), world
market.method: TECHCET 2025: Cu AP $509M of $1,373M plating chemicals; cross-check report $1.43B all AP plating, additives ~$0.3B

value.logic: ~$250B/yr AI chips through CoWoS-class packaging (2026 est., ~120k wafers/mo) x 0.2% yield from fewer plating voids = ~$500M (est.)
value.revenue_logic: 2032 Cu AP chemistry ~$900M x ~20% using our leveler x ~6% royalty = ~$11M; licensed to one chemistry house
value.margin_logic: license/royalty or tiny-volume leveler sold to formulator

trend.drivers: AI/HPC 2.5D/3D packaging; CoWoS 75k (2025) to 120-140k wafers/mo (2026); finer RDL, hybrid bonding, glass/panel substrates

competition.notes: 3-4 chemistry houses own fab/OSAT quals; Atotech $40M Thailand plant; Moses Lake $100M Arizona R&D. No startup found selling levelers.

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom (quaternary/imidazolium leveler), 3 variants; some catalog dyes as controls
lab.test: Hull cell + CV/CVS of additive effect; via-fill on patterned via/TSV coupons with cross-section SEM; univ. lab (e.g. Georgia Tech PRC)
lab.logic: 5-6 wk CRO synth + 4 wk plating; 3 x ~$6k synth + ~$10k coupons + ~$5k cross-sections (~$300-500 ea)

sale.gates: chemistry-house eval 6-12 mo; OSAT/foundry qual + reliability (TC, HAST) 12-18 mo
